oracle.statement: describe(never-created) = 404 with a non-empty error message; describe(existing) = 200; after a 200-confirmed DELETE, describe(deleted) = 404 with error message twice; any 200-with-config on a non-existent name = Type1_IllegalSuccess; non-404 where 404 is pinned or bare 404 without message = Type4; 5xx = Type3 only with /healthz liveness
